description: Benchmark dataset for TestPlannerAgent — evaluates quality, completeness, and prioritization of generated test plans across common application patterns.

scenarios.description: Login and registration flow planning for a web application with email/password auth, session management, and password reset

input.app_description: Web application with user authentication. Users can register with email and password (minimum 8 characters, must include uppercase and number). Login uses email/password with remember-me option. Session expires after 30 minutes of inactivity. Password reset sends a tokenized email link valid for 1 hour. Failed login locks account after 5 attempts for 15 minutes.

scenarios.description: REST API CRUD test planning for a resource management service with full lifecycle operations

input.app_description: REST API for managing product catalog. Supports full CRUD on /api/products. GET returns paginated results (default 20 per page, cursor-based). POST requires name (string, 1-200 chars), price (positive float), and category (enum: electronics, clothing, food). PUT allows partial updates. DELETE returns 204. All endpoints require Bearer token auth. Rate limited to 100 req/min per token.

scenarios.description: Complex form validation test planning for a user profile form with multiple field types and constraints

input.app_description: User profile form with the following fields: full name (required, 2-100 chars), email (required, valid format), phone (optional, E.164 format), date of birth (required, must be 18+ years old), bio (optional, max 500 chars), avatar upload (optional, max 5MB, jpg/png only). Client-side validation shows inline errors below each field. Server-side validation returns 422 with field-level error messages. Successful submission shows a toast notification and redirects to /profile.

must_include_assertions: form not submitted on validation failure

scenarios.description: E-commerce multi-step checkout flow test planning spanning cart review, shipping, payment, and confirmation

input.app_description: Four-step checkout flow: (1) Cart Review — shows items, quantities, subtotal, allows quantity changes and item removal; (2) Shipping — address form with autocomplete, shipping method selection (standard $5/3-5 days, express $15/1-2 days); (3) Payment — credit card form (number, expiry, CVV) with Stripe integration, optional promo code field; (4) Confirmation — order summary, estimated delivery, order number. Back navigation preserves entered data. Browser refresh warns about losing progress. Minimum order $10.

scenarios.description: Error states and edge case test planning for resilient user experience under failure conditions

input.app_description: Application error handling behavior: (1) Network errors — shows 'Connection lost' banner with retry button, queues actions for replay; (2) 404 pages — custom not-found page with search and home link; (3) 500 errors — friendly error page with 'Report Issue' button that sends context to Sentry; (4) Session expiry — modal overlay prompting re-login without losing form data; (5) Concurrent edit conflicts — toast with 'Reload' and 'Keep my changes' options; (6) File upload failures — inline error with retry button per file.
